cases.key: A second ACB handle (player type 0, for the URI engine) is created at every boot whatever the viewer's playback engine, instead of only when the Experimental engine is first offered a play; on webOS 4.4 every Feed Load then times out.
SDL_webOSCursorVisibility is now looked up at runtime and is absent on webOS 3.x's SDL 2.0.4, so hide_cursor() silently does nothing there and the pointer stays on screen, over video too.
Catalan is added as a shipped language without its entry in tools/hud_preview.py's LONG_TITLES corpus, so the HUD preview matrix refuses to plan.

The session owner's cache refill now runs on any app frame, and under Resources::Fixture SessionAdapter::begin_cache_refresh still submits a real storage-worker job, so fixture Bridge tests receive a CacheRefreshed on a timing-dependent frame and can read a developer's real auth.json.
The release spring of a card whose hold the app took is reported by Press::tick as page damage, so under an open item menu the frozen host snapshot is re-captured on every frame of the spring.
The pull request removes the nightly toolchain but leaves .claude/settings.json's permission allowlist naming `cargo +nightly check`, so the documented release check no longer matches it and prompts.

The Segment seek landing check requires a fresh displayed-frame count since Play, which a set that sends no displayed-frame callback never delivers, so every in-place seek there times out and reloads although it is already playing.

The new fs_ramp.frag shader's comment spells a dev-trigger name (plxnative-hwcnt), and shader sources are embedded whole, so the name is compiled into the binary and the packaged-binary scan for dev-trigger surface fails.
Hiding Change profile on a refused roster leaves Sign out as the account menu's first row, where the menu seats its focus, so one stray OK signs the user out.
The Vietnamese headline added to the site's Featured in strip uses characters outside the site font subset's BASE_RANGES, so the subset check fails and the Pages build stops.
A film now ends only on the pipeline's end-of-stream event, but the simulator's HostSink never sends one, so in the simulator a film whose audio outlasts its video hangs at the end.
The underlay preload debounce is never wired: the dispatcher calls want_corners directly, so the reconstruction latches on the first quiescent frame instead of waiting out the rest frames.

Developer builds now SIGABRT the main thread after a 2 s stall, and the CI simulator's first frames on a software renderer legitimately take that long, so simulator jobs abort depending on runner timing.
